backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and prior-day OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength
daily event snapshots before signal date

gate3.note: No core filter is added. The event condition gates only the default-off paper variant; core signals_generated/signals_survived remain unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: VCP breakouts with recent same-ticker event context may have better non-price catalyst support.

2_history_check.exp-20260525-027: Rejected pocket-pivot support gate; volume support is metadata only.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; event variant must pass core guardrails, have >=20 selected trades and at least one trade in each window, beat exp-022 aggregate EV by >=5%, and avoid EV/PnL regression versus exp-022 in every window.

hypothesis: Among exp-20260525-022 QQQ-confirmed volatility-contraction candidates, same-ticker event snapshots before the breakout may identify breakouts with a stronger non-price catalyst.
interpretation: Recent event context passed the core comparison but did not beat exp-022. Treat as attribution only.
next_evidence_needed: Use forward paper outcomes or richer event semantics before revisiting. Do not promote event absence/presence from this frozen-sample attribution.

event_context_gate.date_boundary: event snapshot date must be strictly before signal date

source_exp022_selected_trade_event_attri.interpretation: Read-only attribution of exp-022 selected paper trades by whether same-ticker event snapshots were present before the signal date.

why_not_other_changes: Did not retune VCP, QQQ/SPY, rank, notional, hold-days, exits, or LLM/news. Did not use same-day event snapshots because event timing inside the signal day is ambiguous; only strictly prior snapshots count.
